about: Statements an agent read off saved official pages on 2026-09-22 (Browserbase captures in documents_manifest.jsonl). Each names one node, the passages that state it verbatim on the saved page, and the LRAE requirement-office cells that name it ('resolves', the agent's judgment, noted). org_memory_lrae.py checks every passage against the saved bytes on each build and writes the records as drafts tagged generator.
